name: notify-relay
description: A stateless notification relay for Cloudflare Workers and Node

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p test && tsc --noEmit -p test/node
scripts.build: npm run build:cloudflare && npm run build:node && npm run build:lambda && npm run build:azure
scripts.build:azure: esbuild src/platforms/azure.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --external:@azure/functions-core --outfile=dist/azure/index.js && cp src/platforms/azure/deploy/host.json src/platforms/azure/deploy/package.json dist/azure/
